safe_to_share_first: Tool name; purpose; owner; department; estimated renewal month
do_not_share_first: Credentials; API keys; admin screenshots; vendor portal access
owner_question: Who owns renewal, removal and policy decisions?
escalate_when: No owner can approve disable, renew or consolidate decisions

safe_to_share_first: High-level usage description; duplicate workflows; owner observations
do_not_share_first: User-level activity logs; employee files; private chats; prompt history
owner_question: Which workflows depend on the tool?
escalate_when: Usage may affect HR, clinical, legal, finance or regulated decisions

safe_to_share_first: Plain-language data categories: public, internal, customer, employee, regulated
do_not_share_first: Customer records; patient data; employee data; contracts; source code; confidential documents
owner_question: What data might enter the tool now or later?
escalate_when: Personal, regulated or confidential data may be processed without owner approval

safe_to_share_first: Approximate monthly or annual spend band; billing owner
do_not_share_first: Invoices with payment details; tax IDs; banking data; vendor credentials
owner_question: Which spend needs renewal, pause or consolidation review?
escalate_when: Contract lock-in, auto-renewal or cancellation penalties may exist

safe_to_share_first: Current approval route; blockers; desired next decision
do_not_share_first: Legal opinions; private board papers; procurement documents before scope
owner_question: Who must approve keep, consolidate, replace or govern?
escalate_when: Recommendation requires legal, privacy, security, procurement or compliance advice
